MAXSUN MS-eSport Z890M WIFI ICE DDR5 Motherboard – Ultimate Performance for Gaming & Content Creation

The MAXSUN MS-eSport Z890M WIFI ICE DDR5 Motherboard is designed to deliver unmatched performance for gamers, content creators, and professionals. Built for the latest Intel Core Ultra processors, it combines DDR5 memory support, PCIe 5.0, Wi-Fi 6, and Bluetooth 5.2 to create a high-speed, future-proof platform for any demanding task. Whether you're gaming at ultra settings, editing 4K videos, or running complex simulations, this motherboard is optimized to meet your needs.

Key Features of the MAXSUN MS-eSport Z890M WIFI ICE:

Intel Core Ultra LGA1851 Socket Compatibility
The MAXSUN Z890M WIFI ICE motherboard supports Intel Core Ultra processors with the LGA1851 socket, offering cutting-edge performance and efficiency for gaming, content creation, and multitasking.

DDR5 Memory Support – Overclockable to 8000 MHz
Support for DDR5 memory up to 256GB (overclockable to 8000 MHz) enables fast, high-capacity memory performance, ideal for demanding applications such as video editing, 3D rendering, and heavy multitasking.

PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot for Next-Gen Graphics
Equipped with a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, this motherboard provides blazing-fast data transfer speeds for the latest graphics cards, ensuring a seamless gaming experience and smooth 4K content creation.

Advanced Wireless Connectivity with Wi-Fi 6 & Bluetooth 5.2
Intel AX101 Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 provide faster internet speeds and stable connections for gaming, streaming, and wireless peripherals. Enjoy ultra-low latency and high-speed data transfer for lag-free performance.

Dual M.2 PCIe Slots & Ample Storage Options
Two M.2 PCIe slots (one PCIe 5.0 x4 and one PCIe 4.0 x4) allow for high-speed SSD storage, while three SATA 6Gb/s ports offer additional options for storage expansion, making it easy to handle large gaming libraries, media projects, and professional workloads.

Customizable ARGB Lighting for Personalization
The MAXSUN Z890M WIFI ICE features ARGB lighting that can be customized to match your system's aesthetic. Create your ideal setup with vibrant colors and dynamic lighting effects to make your build stand out.

Sleek White Aesthetic Design
Designed with a white PCB, the MS-eSport Z890M WIFI ICE motherboard adds a sleek and modern look to your PC build, perfect for users who want both style and performance.

Superior Cooling with Multiple Fan Headers
With dedicated fan headers for CPU, SYS_FAN, and PUMP, this motherboard ensures your system remains cool under load, providing enhanced stability during intense gaming sessions or demanding workloads.
